sql.query: SELECT top $rnum user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, case status when '00' then '수강전' when '01' then '수강중' when '02' then '평가중' when '03' then '완료' when '09' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , certication_file_path, certication_file_path_proof, title, dbo.formatDateTime(start_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(end_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') end_dt, tot_cnt, cls_status, case ISNULL(cls_status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '평가중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS cls_status_nm , ISNULL(estimate_pass_yn,'N') estimate_pass_yn, ISNULL(estimate_cnt,0) estimate_cnt, user_class_seq_no, class_no, std_yyyy,start_dd,end_dd,std_end_dd, case when ( cast( user_lecture_end_dt as datetime) - getdate() ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, case when ( cast( std_end_dd + ' 23:59:59' as datetime) - getdate() ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as teminate_yn, case when ISNULL(end_dt, '') = '' then 'Y' when ( cast( end_dt as datetime)+7 - getdate() ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as close_yn, user_lecture_start_dt, user_lecture_end_dt, lecture_div FROM ( select a.user_lecture_seq_no, a.lecture_seq_no, a.status, a.certication_file_path, a.certication_file_path_proof, c.title, d.start_dt, e.estimate_end_dt end_dt, e.status cls_status, e.estimate_pass_yn, e.estimate_cnt, e.user_class_seq_no, e.class_no, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.user_lecture_seq_no desc) rnum, COUNT(a.user_lecture_seq_no) over() tot_cnt, s.std_yyyy, s.start_dd, s.end_dd, s.std_end_dd, a.user_lecture_start_dt as user_lecture_start_dd, dbo.formatDateTime( (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end),'yyyy.mm.dd HH:MI') user_lecture_start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime( case when (cast(s.std_end_dd as int) - cast( dbo.formatDateTime( (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end)+(13 + ISNULL(a.extend_cnt,0) * 13 ) ,'yyyymmdd') as int)) < 0 then s.std_end_dd + ' 23:59:59' else (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end)+(13 + ISNULL(a.extend_cnt,0) * 13 ) end ,'yyyy.mm.dd HH:MI') as user_lecture_end_dt, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( select user_lecture_seq_no , min( t.study_start_dt) start_dt , max( t.estimate_end_dt ) end_dt from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS t where status <> '9' group by user_lecture_seq_no) d ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = d.user_lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS e ON a.curr_class_no = e.user_class_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_SYSTEM s ON a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no AND a.std_yyyy = s.std_yyyy WHERE a.user_seq_no = ? AND a.status <> '99' $addWhere )a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, status_nm, certication_file_path, certication_file_path_proof, title, start_dt, end_dt, tot_cnt, cls_status,cls_status_nm,estimate_pass_yn, estimate_cnt, user_class_seq_no, class_no, std_yyyy,start_dd,end_dd,std_end_dd,end_yn,teminate_yn,close_yn, user_lecture_start_dt,user_lecture_end_dt,lecture_div

sql.query: SELECT top $rnum user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, case status when '00' then '수강전' when '01' then '수강중' when '02' then '평가중' when '03' then '완료' when '09' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , certication_file_path, certication_file_path_proof, title, dbo.formatDateTime(start_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(end_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') end_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(end_dt,'yyyy년 mm월 dd일') end_dt_ko, floor(convert(float, end_dt +3)) float_end_dt, --float_end_dt, addr, corp_addr, corp_nm, building_nm, building_addr, tot_cnt, reg_dt, mod_dt, std_yyyy, down_dt, cert_building_nm,cert_addr_nm,cert_addr, ISNULL((select top 1 proc_yn from tb_survey_cust s where s.user_lecture_seq_no = a.user_lecture_seq_no ),'N') survey_yn, lecture_div FROM ( select a.user_lecture_seq_no, a.lecture_seq_no, a.status, a.certication_file_path, a.certication_file_path_proof, a.std_yyyy, c.title, d.start_dt, case when ( cast( s.end_dd + ' 23:59:59' as datetime) - e.estimate_end_dt ) < 0 then cast( s.end_dd + ' 00:00:00' as datetime) else e.estimate_end_dt end as end_dt, m.addr, mb.cp_addr + ' '+ mb.cp_jibun corp_addr, mb.company corp_nm, m.building_nm, m.building_addr, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.user_lecture_seq_no desc) rnum, COUNT(a.user_lecture_seq_no) over() tot_cnt, ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , t.reg_dt ,120) , 'N') reg_dt, ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , t.mod_dt ,120) , 'N') mod_dt, ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , t.down_dt ,120) , 'N') down_dt, t.building_nm cert_building_nm, t.addr_nm cert_addr_nm, t.addr cert_addr, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( select user_lecture_seq_no , min( t.study_start_dt) start_dt , max( t.estimate_end_dt ) end_dt from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS t where status <> '9' group by user_lecture_seq_no) d ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = d.user_lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS e ON a.curr_class_no = e.user_class_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_MEMBER m LEFT JOIN tb_mb_master mb ON m.cp_code = mb.cp_code and m.ill_no = mb.ill_no ON a.user_seq_no = m.user_seq_no LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CYBER_CERT t ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = t.user_lecture_seq_no LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CYBER_SYSTEM s ON a.STD_YYYY = s.std_yyyy and a.LECTURE_SEQ_NO = s.LECTURE_SEQ_NO WHERE a.user_seq_no = ? AND a.status = '03' )a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, status_nm, certication_file_path, certication_file_path_proof, title, start_dt, end_dt,end_dt_ko, float_end_dt, addr, corp_addr, corp_nm, building_nm, building_addr, tot_cnt, reg_dt, mod_dt, std_yyyy, down_dt, cert_building_nm,cert_addr_nm,cert_addr, survey_yn, lecture_div

sql.query: select a.user_class_seq_no, dbo.formatDateTime(a.study_start_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') study_start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(a.study_end_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') study_end_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(a.estimate_start_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') estimate_start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(a.estimate_end_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') estimate_end_dt, a.status, case ISNULL(a.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '평가중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , c.title, a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, a.user_lecture_seq_no, b.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_CLASS c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and a.class_no = c.class_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE b ON a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no WHERE a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND a.status <> '9'

mapping.getProperty: user_class_seq_no, study_start_dt, study_end_dt, estimate_start_dt, estimate_end_dt, status, status_nm, title, lecture_seq_no, class_no, user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_div

sql.query: select a.estimate_seq_no, a.exam_seq_no, a.user_class_seq_no, a.exam_no exam_num, b.exam_no, b.exam_title, b.exam_type, b.lecture_seq_no, b.class_no, c.answer, b.chart_path, b.exam_open_time from tb_cyber_estimate a left join tb_cyber_exam_bank b on a.exam_seq_no = b.exam_seq_no left outer join tb_cyber_answer c on a.estimate_seq_no = c.estimate_seq_no where a.user_class_seq_no =? order by a.exam_no

mapping.getProperty: estimate_seq_no, exam_seq_no, user_class_seq_no, exam_num, exam_no, exam_title, exam_type, lecture_seq_no, class_no, answer, chart_path, exam_open_time

sql.query: select a.exam_seq_no, a.exam_no, a.exam_title, a.exam_type, a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no from tb_cyber_exam_bank a , tb_cyber_user_class b where a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.class_no = b.class_no and b.user_class_seq_no =? and isnull( use_yn , 'Y') = 'Y'

mapping.getProperty: exam_seq_no, exam_no, exam_title, exam_type, lecture_seq_no, class_no

sql.query: select top(10) a.exam_seq_no, a.exam_no, a.exam_title, a.exam_type, a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no from ( select a.exam_seq_no, a.exam_no, a.exam_title, a.exam_type, a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, a.EXAM_OPEN_TIME, b.USER_CLASS_SEQ_NO, newid() id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_OPEN_TIME Order by newid() ) as Seq from tb_cyber_exam_bank a , tb_cyber_user_class b where a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.class_no = b.class_no and b.user_class_seq_no =1 and isnull( use_yn , 'Y') = 'Y' ) a where seq = 1

mapping.getProperty: exam_seq_no, exam_no, exam_title, exam_type, lecture_seq_no, class_no

sql.query: select a.exam_seq_no, a.item_seq_no, a.item_no, a.item_nm, a.check_yn from tb_cyber_exam_item a where a.exam_seq_no = ? order by item_seq_no

insert into TB_CYBER_ESTIMATE( exam_seq_no , user_class_seq_no ,exam_no ) select a.exam_seq_no, a.user_class_seq_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( order by a.EXAM_OPEN_TIME ) no from ( select a.exam_seq_no, a.EXAM_OPEN_TIME, b.user_class_seq_no, newid() id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_OPEN_TIME Order by newid() ) as seq from tb_cyber_exam_bank a , tb_cyber_user_class b where a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.class_no = b.class_no and b.user_class_seq_no = ? and isnull( use_yn , 'Y') = 'Y' ) a where seq = 1
insert into TB_CYBER_ESTIMATE( exam_seq_no , user_class_seq_no ,exam_no ) values( ? , ? , ?)
insert into TB_CYBER_ANSWER( estimate_seq_no , answer , user_class_seq_no) values( ? , ? , ?)
delete from TB_CYBER_ESTIMATE where user_class_seq_no = ?
delete from TB_CYBER_ANSWER where user_class_seq_no = ?
delete from TB_CYBER_ANSWER where estimate_seq_no = ?

UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS SET status = ?, estimate_start_dt = ( case ISNULL(estimate_start_dt,'') when '' then getdate() else estimate_start_dt end ), study_end_dt = (case ISNULL(study_end_dt,'') when '' then getdate() else study_end_dt end) WHERE user_class_seq_no = ?

UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS SET status = ?, estimate_end_dt = (case ISNULL(estimate_end_dt,'') when '' then getdate() else estimate_end_dt end), estimate_cnt = ?, estimate_point = ?, estimate_pass_yn = ? WHERE user_class_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS SET status = ? WHERE user_class_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE SET status = ?, curr_class_no = ? WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE SET user_lecture_start_dt = ( CASE WHEN user_lecture_start_dt IS NULL THEN getdate() ELSE user_lecture_start_dt END ) WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?

select count(a.user_lecture_seq_no) tot_cnt from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_CLASS c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and a.class_no = c.class_no WHERE a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND a.status <> '9' AND ISNULL(a.estimate_pass_yn,'N') != 'Y'
select ISNULL(a.estimate_cnt,0) estimate_cnt from tb_cyber_user_class a where a.user_class_seq_no = ?

select ISNULL(sum(1) , 0 ) point from tb_cyber_answer a, tb_cyber_estimate b, tb_cyber_exam_item c where a.estimate_seq_no = b.estimate_seq_no and b.exam_seq_no = c.exam_seq_no and a.answer = c.item_seq_no and c.check_yn = 'Y' and a.user_class_seq_no = ?

select ISNULL(b.estimate_pass_point,50) estimate_pass_point from tb_cyber_user_class a, tb_cyber_class b where a.class_no = b.class_no and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.user_class_seq_no = ?

select user_class_seq_no, class_no, ISNULL(estimate_pass_yn, 'N') estimate_pass_yn from tb_cyber_user_class a, (select top 1 user_lecture_seq_no , lecture_seq_no from tb_cyber_user_lecture t where user_seq_no = ? order by user_lecture_seq_no desc ) b where a.user_lecture_seq_no = b.user_lecture_seq_no and a.status <> '9' order by class_no

select top 1 status, case when ( cast( x.user_lecture_end_dt as datetime) - getdate() ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn from ( select a.status, a.user_lecture_seq_no, dbo.formatDateTime( a.user_lecture_start_dt+(13 + ISNULL(a.extend_cnt,0) * 13 ) ,'yyyy.mm.dd HH:MI') as user_lecture_end_dt from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a, TB_CYBER_SYSTEM s,TB_CYBER_LECTURE c WHERE a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no AND a.status in ( '01' , '02' , '09' ) AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.user_lecture_seq_no in (select top 1 user_lecture_seq_no from tb_cyber_user_lecture t where user_seq_no = ? order by user_lecture_seq_no desc ) AND a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no AND a.std_yyyy = s.std_yyyy AND s.start_dd <= dbo.formatDateTime( getdate() , 'yyyymmdd') AND s.std_end_dd >= dbo.formatDateTime( getdate() , 'yyyymmdd')
) x
select a.exam_seq_no, a.check_yn from tb_cyber_exam_item a where a.exam_seq_no = ? and a.item_seq_no = ?

UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE SET extend_cnt = isnull( extend_cnt, 0) + (((cast( getdate() - (case status when '00' then getdate() else user_lecture_start_dt end ) as int)-13)/13)+2 ) WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?

INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_CERT ( user_lecture_seq_no ,lecture_seq_no ,user_seq_no ,user_id ,ssn
,user_nm ,building_nm ,tel_no ,addr ,corp_nm
,addr_nm ,end_dt ,float_end_dt ,cert_div ,reg_dt ) values( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate() )
UPDATE TB_CYBER_CERT SET down_dt = getdate() WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND user_id = ?

SELECT a.user_lecture_seq_no ,a.lecture_seq_no ,a.user_seq_no ,user_id ,ssn ,user_nm ,building_nm ,tel_no ,addr ,corp_nm ,addr_nm ,end_dt ,float_end_dt ,cert_div ,ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , a.reg_dt ,120) , 'N') reg_dt ,ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , mod_dt ,120) , 'N') mod_dt ,ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , down_dt ,120) , 'N') down_dt ,ISNULL( b.std_yyyy , '$std_yyyy') std_yyyy ,lecture_div FROM TB_CYBER_CERT a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE b ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = b.user_lecture_seq_no LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE c ON b.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no WHERE a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND a.user_id = ?

select c.user_lecture_seq_no, c.lecture_seq_no, a.user_seq_no, a.user_id, (case when len(ssn) > 6 then substring(ssn, 0, 7) + '-' + substring(ssn , 7, 13) else ssn end) ssn, user_nm, building_nm, tel_no, addr, (case when a.cp_code is null or a.cp_code = '' then a.CORP_NM else b.company end) as corp_nm, b.cp_addr + ' '+ isnull(b.cp_jibun,'') as addr_nm, dbo.formatDateTime( e.estimate_end_dt,'yyyy년 mm월 dd일') end_dt, --replace( convert( varchar(10) , e.estimate_end_dt , 120) , '-' , '.') end_dt, floor(convert(float, e.estimate_end_dt +3)) float_end_dt, '1' cert_div, ISNULL( CONVERT( varchar , getdate() ,120) , 'N') reg_dt, ISNULL( c.std_yyyy , dbo.formatDateTime(GETDATE(),'yyyy') ) std_yyyy, lecture_div from tb_cyber_member a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_mb_master b ON a.cp_code = b.cp_code and a.ill_no = b.ill_no ,tb_cyber_user_lecture c LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE d ON c.lecture_seq_no = d.lecture_seq_no ,TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS e where a.user_seq_no = c.user_seq_no and c.USER_LECTURE_SEQ_NO = ? and c.curr_class_no = e.user_class_seq_no AND a.user_id = ?
